title: Words of Wisdom: Representational Harms in Learning From AI Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting a Visual Question Generation (VQG) dataset specifically from Black crowdworkers and conducting interviews with human evaluators to assess how they index the racial identity behind the AI-generated language and perceive representational harms.

Gathering VQG data from female crowdworkers and interviewing evaluators to examine how gender identities are encoded in the generated questions and whether the language reinforces stereotypes or causes representational harm.

Building a VQG dataset from crowdworkers aged 40 and older, and conducting qualitative interviews with evaluators to understand the indexing of age identity in AI communication and its potential for representational harm.

Analyzing human-produced and AI-generated text for differences in question length, formality, predicates of personal taste, grammar, and usage to evaluate how linguistic varieties can encode cultural identity and potentially marginalize non-dominant groups.
